name.description: Environment name shown in the environment picker.

variables.description: Environment variables, used as {{name}} in requests. They win over collection variables.

agentAutoApproveReads.description: Skip the approval for GET, HEAD and OPTIONS requests without a body that an agent sends in this environment. Off by default.

secret.description: Secret reference ${secret:name}. Set the value in Kira, under Api, Environments, Secrets.

agent.description: Let agents use this variable by name in API requests they send. Off by default. An agent never sees the value.

agentHosts.description: Hosts an agent may send this secret to. Required on a secret with agent: true. Entries are host, host:port or *.example.com for subdomains; prefix http:// to allow plain HTTP. A request or redirect to another host is blocked.
